routeSelectionNote: The packet states the route it was built for: sealing a conviction for conduct that is no longer prohibited, on JDF 2371 with JDF 2374 as the proposed order, under the authority section 1 of the form states. The ground itself is printed text in section 5 and carries no widget, so there is no route election to make on it. What is left to the participant is what the route does not settle: which court the case was in, which offence class it was, which agencies hold records, whether the drug and psilocybin questions apply, and how they want to attend and be understood in court. Each is disclosed by name.
